ei.subject: 수능특강Light

fullPassage: A hunter/forager’s relationship to animals differs from that of a domesticator. For the forager, there can be a deep mutual interaction with other species, with humans shaping much of their activity to those of the animals and the other species responding to the pressures emanating from human predation. For example, across millennia human groups in northern parts of the world structured their lives around the migrations of herds of caribou or reindeer or buffalo, who in turn shaped their ranging and feeding behaviors based on human predation. In addition to the availability of food resources, human foragers usually reside in locations that are favorable in terms of safety and key non-foraging activities. But with domestication, relationships move beyond predator-prey interactions to a much more direct and intensive mutual reshaping of bodies and lifeways. The investment in one another and the processes of relationships become more integrated and interreliant.

questions.passage: A hunter/forager’s relationship to animals differs from that of a domesticator. For the forager, there can be a deep (A)[hostile / mutual] interaction with other species, with humans shaping much of their activity to those of the animals and the other species responding to the pressures emanating from human predation. For example, across millennia human groups in northern parts of the world (B)[structured / abandoned] their lives around the migrations of herds of caribou or reindeer or buffalo, who in turn shaped their ranging and feeding behaviors based on human predation. In addition to the availability of food resources, human foragers usually reside in locations that are (C)[unfavorable / favorable] in terms of safety and key non-foraging activities. But with domestication, relationships move beyond predator-prey interactions to a much more direct and intensive mutual reshaping of bodies and lifeways. The investment in one another and the processes of relationships become more integrated and interreliant.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 상호작용은 '상호적'이다. 인간 집단은 이주를 중심으로 삶을 '구조화했다'. 채집인은 '유리한' 장소에 거주한다.
det.analysis:
✅ ① mutual — structured — favorable: 원문 일치
❌ ② hostile(적대적인)은 원문 mutual(상호적인)의 반의어
❌ ③ abandoned(버린)은 원문 structured(구조화한)의 반의어
❌ ④ unfavorable(불리한)은 원문 favorable(유리한)의 반의어

questions.passage: A hunter/forager’s relationship to animals (A)[derives / differs] from that of a domesticator. But with domestication, relationships move beyond predator-prey interactions to a much more direct and intensive mutual reshaping of bodies and lifeways. questions.stem: 다음 글의 (A), (B), (C)에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.korean: 수렵/채집인의 관계는 가축사육자와 '다르다'. 인간 포식에서 '발산되는' 압력. 관계가 더 '통합적'이 된다.
det.analysis:
❌ ① derives(유래하다)는 원문 differs(다르다)와 의미 불일치
❌ ② retreating(후퇴하는)은 원문 emanating(발산되는)의 반의어

det.korean: 채집인에게 '깊은' 상호작용이 있다. 가축화로 더 '집중적인' 재형성. 관계가 더 '상호의존적'이 된다.

det.korean: 원문은 structured(구조화했다)인데 neglected(방치했다)로 교체. 이주를 중심으로 삶을 '구조화했다'는 문맥.

✅ ② predation(포식): 인간 포식에서 나오는 압력이라는 문맥에 적절
❌ ③ neglected(방치했다) → structured(구조화했다): 이주를 중심으로 삶을 '구조화했다'는 문맥이므로 neglected는 부적절

det.korean: 원문은 responding(반응하는)인데 indifferent(무관심한)로 교체. 다른 종이 인간 포식의 압력에 '반응하는' 문맥.

det.korean: 원문은 direct(직접적인)인데 indirect(간접적인)로 교체. 가축화로 더 '직접적이고' 집중적인 재형성이라는 문맥.

questions.stem: 다음 (A), (B)의 밑줄 친 relationship의 의미로 가장 적절한 것끼리 짝지은 것은?

det.analysis:
✅ ① (A) 상관관계 — (B) 유대관계: (A)는 온도와 식물 성장 간의 과학적 '상관관계', (B)는 수렵채집인과 동물 간의 깊은 '유대관계'
❌ ② 의미가 뒤바뀜
❌ ③ (B) 친족관계는 혈연을 뜻하므로 종 간 관계와 불일치
❌ ④ (A) 친족관계는 과학적 변수 관계와 불일치

questions.stem: 다음 영영 정의에 해당하는 단어로 가장 적절한 것은? "the act of hunting and killing other animals for food"

det.korean: predation = 포식 (다른 동물을 먹이로 사냥하여 죽이는 행위)
det.analysis:
❌ ① migration(이주): 동물의 이동이지 사냥이 아님
❌ ② domestication(가축화): 동물 길들이기이지 포식이 아님
❌ ③ foraging(채집): 식량 찾기이지 사냥이 아님
✅ ④ predation(포식): 정의에 정확히 부합

questions.passage: For the forager, there can be a deep mutual interaction with other species, with humans shaping much of their activity to those of the animals and the other species __________ (respond) to the pressures emanating from human predation.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

respond → ____

det.korean: 전치사 with 뒤 독립분사구문에서 현재분사(-ing) 형태가 필요. '반응하면서'.
det.analysis: with + 목적어(the other species) + 현재분사(responding) = 부대상황 분사구문. 종이 '반응하는' 능동 관계이므로 현재분사 필수. respond → responding.

questions.passage: In addition to the __________ (available) of food resources, human foragers usually reside in locations that are favorable in terms of safety and key non-foraging activities.
questions.stem:
다음 글의 빈칸에 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞은 형태로 바꿔 쓰시오. (영어로, 1단어)

available → ____

det.korean: 관사 the 뒤에 명사 형태가 필요. '식량 자원의 가용성'이라는 의미.
det.analysis: the + _____ + of 구조에서 명사가 필수. 형용사 available을 명사 availability로 변환. the availability of food resources = 식량 자원의 가용성. available → availability.
det.tip: the + 명사 + of: 형용사 → 명사 변환 (available → availability)

questions.passage: A hunter/forager’s relationship to animals differs from that of a domesticator. For the forager, there can be a deep mutual interaction with other species, with humans shaping much of their activity to those of the animals and the other species responding to the pressures emanating from human predation. For example, across millennia human groups in northern parts of the world structured their lives around the migrations of herds of caribou or reindeer or buffalo, who in turn shaped their ranging and feeding behaviors based on human predation. In addition to the availability of food resources, human foragers usually reside in locations that are favorable in terms of safety and key non-foraging activities. But with domestication, relationships move beyond __________ to a much more direct and intensive mutual reshaping of bodies and lifeways. The investment in one another and the processes of relationships become more integrated and interreliant.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 포식자-먹이 상호작용. 가축화로 관계가 '포식자-먹이 상호작용'을 넘어선다는 문맥.
det.analysis:
❌ ① deep mutual interaction(깊은 상호 상호작용): 앞 부분 채집인 맥락의 표현으로 빈칸 위치와 불일치
✅ ② predator-prey interactions(포식자-먹이 상호작용): move beyond ___ to a much more direct... 구조에서 넘어서는 대상
❌ ③ non-foraging activities(비채집 활동): 앞 문장 거주지 맥락의 표현으로 불일치
❌ ④ food resources(식량 자원): 앞 문장의 표현으로 가축화 전환 맥락과 불일치
det.tip: move beyond A to B = A를 넘어 B로 나아가다

questions.passage: A hunter/forager’s relationship to animals differs from that of a domesticator. For the forager, there can be a deep mutual interaction with other species, with humans shaping much of their activity to those of the animals and the other species responding to the pressures emanating from human predation. For example, across millennia human groups in northern parts of the world structured their lives around the migrations of herds of caribou or reindeer or buffalo, who in turn shaped their ranging and feeding behaviors based on human predation. In addition to the availability of food resources, human foragers usually reside in locations that are favorable in terms of safety and key non-foraging activities. But with domestication, relationships move beyond predator-prey interactions to a much more direct and intensive mutual __________. The investment in one another and the processes of relationships become more integrated and interreliant.
questions.stem: 다음 글의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?

det.korean: 몸과 생활 방식의 재형성. 가축화로 더 직접적이고 집중적인 상호 '몸과 생활 방식의 재형성'이라는 문맥.
det.analysis:
✅ ① reshaping of bodies and lifeways(몸과 생활 방식의 재형성): 가축화가 이끄는 직접적이고 집중적인 상호 재형성
❌ ② migrations of herds(떼의 이주): 중간 부분 순록 예시로 가축화 결과와 불일치
❌ ③ pressures emanating from predation(포식에서 나오는 압력): 앞 부분 채집인 맥락으로 불일치
❌ ④ availability of food resources(식량 자원의 가용성): 중간 부분 거주지 맥락으로 불일치
